coverage.method: Director Compensation tables from every definitive proxy filed 2019-2026 (DEF 14A 2019-04-30, 2020-04-24, 2021-04-23, 2022-04-22, 2023-04-21, 2024-04-26, 2025-04-25, 2026-04-24), one table per fiscal year FY2018-FY2025 (calendar years): 77 rows (8, 10, 10, 10, 11, 10, 9, 9). Every table has Fees Earned or Paid in Cash, Stock Awards, All Other Compensation and Total columns only; the other columns are recorded as 0, and every row's components sum to its printed total. Sundar Pichai (CEO) is excluded from every table; Page, Brin and (FY2018) Schmidt are excluded from the FY2018-FY2019 tables, while Greene (FY2018-FY2019), Schmidt (FY2019) and Page/Brin (FY2020-FY2025, $1 salary) are listed with employee pay and recorded as printed. Checked with no director table: the only 10-K/A in the period (2019-02-06, auditor-consent fix, no Part III) and all 20 DEFA14As filed 2019-2026; the 2022 PRE 14A (2022-04-08) carries a table identical to the DEF 14A and is not recorded. No DEFR14A or DEFC14A was filed. Submissions feed fetched 2026-10-14 (latest filing 2026-10-02).
